title: Paul McCartney live: Value City Arena, Columbus | 2005
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Value City Arena in the Schottenstein Center in Columbus, Ohio, USA, on 22 October 2005.

It was the 18th show of the US Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between September and November 2005. This show was seen by 15,051 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at the Value City Arena on 10 October 2002 for the Driving World Tour. Ringo Starr had also played there on 22 February 1999.
